title: Bag of Scrambled Mystery
body:
"How Could they fit all that in a bag?"

Description

Bag of Scrambled Mystery gives you random items from an Easter event when you open it. According to the description, the chance of getting a Grabbit is 1 in 777 (0.129%), and the chance of getting an Easter Moai is 1 in 100 (1%).

History

  • Was added on the 2025 Easter event;
  • On the 2025 Easter event, it was sold at Hop 'N' Shop.
